faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.label: FAQ
faq.description: Pricing, timelines, SEO, maintenance: all the answers to common questions about my freelance web development services in Belgium.

q1.question: Why work with you instead of an agency or another freelancer?
q1.answer: Because I combine strategy, development and support. Many people can produce a website, even more so with AI. My work starts before the code: understanding your market, clarifying your difference, shaping your offer and building a path that makes people want to contact you. You have one direct contact from the first call to launch.

q2.question: How much does it cost to create a website?
q2.answer: The price depends on the project, number of pages, level of strategy, support and required features. As a guide: a landing page starts around €800, a professional showcase website between €1,500 and €3,000, and a bespoke business tool is quoted individually. I work on a fixed-price basis defined during the free initial call, so you know the total cost before starting, with no surprise overruns.

q3.question: What is the delivery timeline?
q3.answer: A standard showcase website is delivered within 2 to 4 weeks. A landing page can be ready in 1 to 2 weeks. These timelines include design, development, revisions and deployment. Precise dates are set from the project kickoff — no vague 'soon'.

q4.question: Do you offer maintenance after launch?
q4.answer: Yes. After delivery, I offer monthly maintenance packages covering content updates, technical adjustments and ongoing SEO performance optimisation. Maintenance is optional but ensures your site stays fast, secure and well-ranked over time.

q5.question: Will my site be optimised for Google?
q5.answer: Yes. Every site is built with solid SEO foundations: semantic HTML, optimised metadata, performance, mobile compatibility and Schema.org structured data. But SEO is not just technical: we also work on the offer, pages, proof points and questions your clients ask before contacting you.

q6.question: How does the collaboration work?
q6.answer: Three steps: a free initial call to understand your business, clients and goals; a strategy phase to clarify the offer, messages, proof points and path; then development with regular checkpoints. You stay involved without having to manage the technical side.

q7.question: Will my site be technically ready for AI search engines?
q7.answer: Yes. I include the useful technical foundations: Schema.org structured data, an llms.txt file for AI crawlers, semantic HTML and structured content. I do not sell a magic promise: AI makes the market more competitive, so you mainly need a clear offer, useful content, credible proof and authority that compounds over time.

q8.question: Is WordPress or a custom-built website better?
q8.answer: WordPress suits simple blogs or very small budgets. For a professional showcase site, a custom build with Next.js outperforms on every metric: speed (Lighthouse score 95+), security without vulnerable plugins, advanced technical SEO and complete customisation. The cost is comparable but the performance and longevity are incomparable.

q9.question: How do I know if my current website needs to be rebuilt?
q9.answer: Concrete warning signs: Google PageSpeed score below 70, not mobile-responsive, no update in over 2 years, no clients contacting you through the site, or difficult to modify. If two or more apply to you, a redesign would deliver a fast return on investment.

q10.question: Why isn't my website appearing on Google?
q10.answer: The most common causes: site too slow (poor Core Web Vitals), content not indexed by Google, keywords missing from title and description tags, no inbound links (backlinks), or a technical crawlability issue. A quick audit during the free initial call identifies the exact cause and defines the action plan.

q11.question: Do you work only in Nivelles or across Belgium?
q11.answer: I work with clients across Belgium — Brussels, Liège, Namur, Charleroi, Mons, Louvain-la-Neuve and beyond. Distance is not an obstacle: the process is structured to work efficiently regardless of location, with regular checkpoints throughout the project.

q12.question: Do you offer packages or only one-off projects?
q12.answer: Both. For a one-off project (showcase site, landing page), I work on a fixed quote defined upfront. For ongoing support, I offer monthly maintenance packages covering updates, SEO optimisations, content adjustments and technical support. We define the right formula together during the free initial call.

accenture.details: Software Engineer on the European Commission's CBAM project. Engineering and optimizing backend services for high-availability regulatory systems deployed on Kubernetes. Integrating Apache Kafka for event-driven architecture and managing container orchestration in production.

proximus.details: Full-stack developer on the Webshop platform. Developing and scaling reactive microservices in Node.js, designing features with Angular and integrating RESTful and GraphQL services in a distributed environment.
